business_summary: NEC Capital Solutions Limited provides financial services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Leasing Business, Finance Business, Investment Business, and Other Business. The Leasing Business segment is involved in the leasing, rental, and installment sale of information communication equipment, office equipment, and other various facilities and equipment; and sale of goods related to leasing, sale of properties due to expiration or early cancellation, maintenance services for leased equipment, etc. The Finance Business segment comprises money lending, factoring, securities investment, etc. for the purpose of receiving dividend income. The Investment Business segment engages in investment in venture companies for the purpose of receiving proceeds from the sale of securities, etc., as well as assets, real estate, and advisory businesses. The Other Business segment includes businesses in the field of energy, tourism, agriculture, healthcare, PFI/PPP business, generation and sale of solar power, and other services. The company offers financial services, such as factoring, settlement and collection agency, and receivables flow management. It serves government agencies, local governments, large corporations, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was formerly known as NEC Leasing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NEC Capital Solutions Limited in November 2008. NEC Capital Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: NEC Capital Solutions Limited는 일본 및 국제적으로 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 임대사업, 금융사업, 투자사업, 기타사업 등 4개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 리스사업부문은 정보통신기기, 사무기기, 기타 각종 시설 및 장비의 리스, 렌탈, 할부판매 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 리스 관련 물품 판매, 만기 또는 중도해지로 인한 부동산 매각, 임대장비 유지보수 서비스 등을 제공합니다. 금융사업부문은 배당수익을 목적으로 하는 자금대출, 팩토링, 증권투자 등으로 구성됩니다. 투자사업부문은 유가증권 등의 매각대금을 받을 목적으로 벤처기업에 대한 투자와 자산, 부동산, 자문사업 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 기타 사업 부문에는 에너지, 관광, 농업, 의료, PFI/PPP 사업, 태양광 발전 및 판매, 기타 서비스 분야의 사업이 포함됩니다. 팩토링, 결제 및 추심 대행, 채권 흐름 관리 등의 금융 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다. 그것은 봉사한다
